metaData.originalTitle: AI 不缺智商缺纪律：我的 Harness 工程化实践
metaData.title: AI Doesn't Lack Intelligence, It Lacks Discipline: My Harness Engineering Practice
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Based on two months of engineering practice, the author proposes a framework (harness) that solidifies AI coding behavior into an executable and evaluable engineering system, with the core idea of replacing prompt persuasion with structural constraints to address issues like random workflows, context pollution, and repeated mistakes in AI coding.
metaData.summary: This article systematically introduces an AI coding engineering framework (harness) practiced internally at Alibaba Cloud by the author. The author first points out that the bottleneck in AI coding has shifted from model capability to process engineering. Models are smart enough but unstable, and stability must be provided by an external framework. The article details the five-layer architecture of the harness: a permanent entry layer (CLAUDE.md), an atomic rules layer (7 single-responsibility rules), a role Agent layer (dispatcher scheduling + three-role review + process execution), an on-demand context layer (context/), and an execution support layer (skills/commands/evals). The core design philosophy is to 'manage context like a budget,' combating AI's forgetfulness and uncertainty through responsibility isolation, externalized state, and gating mechanisms. The article also introduces an evaluation platform based on deterministic scoring (zero LLM calls), treating the harness itself as the test subject and quantitatively assessing each execution across 7 dimensions (process completeness, output quality, code correctness, efficiency, security compliance, iteration capability, interface acceptance). Finally, the author candidly discusses the system's boundaries and technical debt, and looks ahead to frontier directions like structured memory layers and code knowledge graphs. The entire article embodies a transferable mindset: any AI workflow with sufficient capability but unstable output can be engineered through layered constraints, externalized state, and deterministic scoring.

mainPoints.point: The bottleneck in AI coding is shifting from model capability to process engineering; stability must be provided by an external framework.
mainPoints.explanation: Models are smart enough, but their output is unstable. Piling on prompts creates technical debt, while building a framework creates an asset. The core of the harness is to solidify 'how AI should work' into an executable, constrainable, and evaluable engineering framework.

mainPoints.point: The core design of the harness is to 'manage context like a budget,' combating context pollution through layered loading.
mainPoints.explanation: The permanent layer is compressed to ≤8K, with deep content loaded on demand. Through a dispatcher state machine and file-based handoffs, responsibility isolation and state externalization are achieved, degrading the main session to a pure executor and eliminating context pollution.

mainPoints.point: Process enforcement must be externalized from LLM reasoning to deterministic infrastructure.
mainPoints.explanation: Gates must be deterministic code (G1-G8 gate walls + hook interception), independent of the context window, and fail-closed (deny by default). The system cannot rely on the model 'remembering' which step to execute next.

mainPoints.point: The core value of the evaluation platform is to transform 'changing the harness by feel' into 'a score after changes, comparability between good and bad, and evidence for rollbacks.'
mainPoints.explanation: Using 100% Python deterministic logic, zero LLM calls, and requiring three benchmark runs to produce identical hashes, the platform scores each execution of the harness across 7 dimensions, driving a self-improvement loop.

mainPoints.point: This engineering model is transferable to any AI workflow that is 'capable enough but unstable in output, and whose process is observable.'
mainPoints.explanation: The core is layered constraints, externalized state, and deterministic scoring. The boundary is its reliance on process observability, and its value diminishes as models improve their ability to self-enforce process discipline.

keyQuotes: To deal with AI's uncertainty, piling on prompts creates debt, but building a framework creates an asset.
Context is not a 'free buffer' where bigger is better; it's a scarce resource that needs careful management.
Prefer a reproducible 'rough score' over a drifting 'precise score.'
What truly drives architectural evolution is never 'wanting it to be better,' but 'the current approach has already broken down.'
The model is responsible for being smart; we are responsible for making it follow the rules.

relatedArticles.title: Harness Is Not the Goal, Knowledge Is the Moat — Knowledge Accumulation Practices of an AI Engineering Delivery Team
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Based on the engineering delivery practices of an AI Team, this article proposes that knowledge accumulation is more important than workflow orchestration, and systematically introduces a complete methodology encompassing a five-layer knowledge storage architecture, a three-level maturity system, and how workflows serve knowledge accumulation.

relatedArticles.title: AI R&D Automation: Wiki Knowledge Base + Skill Pack
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details how to build a continuously growing team knowledge base and a supporting expert skill pack based on the LLM-Wiki model and the Obsidian platform to achieve AI-driven R&D automation.

relatedArticles.title: Harness Engineering: How I Spent a Week Boosting AI Coding Rate to 90% in an Enterprise App
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically introduces Harness Engineering, a new AI coding paradigm that elevates the AI code rate of an enterprise Java application from 25% to over 90% by building a four-element system of rules, skills, knowledge, and change management.

relatedArticles.title: Understanding Harness Engineering: Finding the Shell That Keeps AI from Going Rogue—Insights from 14 Engineering Articles | Hao's Trend Talk
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides an in-depth analysis of "Harness Engineering," a core technology in the AI Agent field. It reveals how to compensate for model shortcomings through a three-layer management architecture and proposes the logic of "Compensation Surface Migration" that evolves with model capabilities.

relatedArticles.title: Redefining Skill Development: A Step-by-Step Guide & One-Stop Development Assistant Launch
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically introduces the concept of AI Agent Skill, including its directory structure, writing standards, release process, and cross-platform challenges. It also launches a one-stop Skill development assistant, skill-dev-aio, designed to free developers from tedious tool learning and allow them to focus on experience and judgment.

relatedArticles.title: OpenClaw and Hermes: A Comprehensive Review of AI Agent Architecture from Source Code
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically summarizes the design trade-offs and engineering practices of Agent architecture in core modules such as message routing, memory management, context engineering, and security sandboxing, through an in-depth analysis of the source code of two open-source AI Agent frameworks: OpenClaw and Hermes.

relatedArticles.title: From Toy to Productivity: Demystifying AI Agent Harness Engineering Through Real Projects
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Based on the practical experience of the real-world project Aegis, this article systematically elaborates on the concept, architectural boundaries, and implementation methods of Harness Engineering. It argues that in enterprise engineering environments, constraining and governing non-deterministic large models by building a control plane is the key to transforming AI Agents from toys into productive tools, and it drives the migration of the engineer's role from code executor to goal controller.

relatedArticles.title: Understanding Hermes in One Article: How the New Top-Tier Agent Self-Evolves from Experience
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides an in-depth analysis of the core innovation of the Hermes Agent—the Skills closed-loop system—detailing its complete implementation mechanism, from experience extraction and knowledge storage to intelligent retrieval and self-improvement, along with its engineering trade-offs and security considerations.
